{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
'''''Geonosian Debriefings, Vol. III''''', was a collection of debriefings belonging to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] on the topic of the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]], the battle that started the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a conflict between the Republic and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. This collection included a debriefing from [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] [[CT-1226]], on his experience during the battle.

==Behind the scenes==
The debriefings were first mentioned in ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', an extensive [[Star Wars: Essential Guides|guide]] dedicated to the conflicts in the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]], written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]] and released in [[2012]].
